description_en: Queries the details of a specified ACK cluster connector
description_zh: 查询指定ACK集群连接器详情
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw describe-ack-cluster-connector --connector-id ac-7c1bad6c3cc84c33baab --lang zh --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAckClusterConnector

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the ACK cluster connector. You can obtain the value from:
- [DescribeAckClusterConnectors](~~DescribeAckClusterConnectors~~): Lists ACK cluster connectors
parameters.help_zh:
ACK集群连接器ID。取值来源：
- [DescribeAckClusterConnectors](~~DescribeAckClusterConnectors~~)：批量查询ACK集群连接器列表
parameters.name: connector_id

parameters.help_en: The language in which the health status error reason of the ACK cluster connector is displayed
parameters.help_zh: 显示ACK集群连接器健康状态错误原因的语言类型
parameters.name: lang
